_comment: 20260910181447: cash_seat_moves.resolved_at - when a move left pending, stamped by the BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF state trigger zz_cash_seat_move_resolved (fn_cash_seat_move_stamp_resolved). The three planners' 60-second back-off for a refused player is keyed on it instead of on created_at, which is the plan time and had usually already lapsed by the time the refusal landed (finding A7 of the 2026-09-09 must-move audit).
